:::{#exm-euler-number}
#### Euler's number is irrational

$e = 2.71828\ldots$ is an
[irrational number](number-systems.qmd#def-irrational-numbers),
so no fraction equals it exactly.
The fraction $\frac{19}{7} = 2.714\ldots$ is close,
but $\frac{19}{7} \ne e$
[@wikipedia_e_mathematical_constant].

:::
